lane: graded from official Figma help and developer pages
platform: Design suite whose Figma Sites (open beta) designs, prototypes and publishes responsive sites with a CMS from the same canvas
Published sites get a figma.site subdomain; custom domains on all paid plans, with SSL provisioned automatically
Exporting a site's code is not documented in the pages read
Official Figma MCP server (remote or desktop) gives agents design context and can write native content to Design, FigJam and Slides
REST API reads files, layers and their properties, comments, variables and usage, with webhooks
Code layers and code components in Figma Sites are React (.tsx); Figma Make builds React apps from prompts
add.vp: Figma Sites designs and publishes responsive sites with a CMS from the design canvas, with hosting, custom domains, Figma AI images and an official MCP server, and Figma Design and Draw cover most of the vector rows. Site forms, localization and commerce were not found in the official pages read.

FW-001: Create, duplicate, delete, reorder pages documented; rename and route uniqueness rules not found; no nesting.
FW-002: Layers panel shows nested hierarchy of frames and layers; each layer shows its HTML tag.
FW-003: Pages can be reordered by drag; layer reparent and cycle validation not described in docs read.
FW-004: Auto layout sets direction, gap, alignment and wrap, and is used for responsive pages in Sites.
FW-005: Grid auto layout flow has rows, columns, gaps and spans, but its page does not mention Sites.
FW-006: Inline and full-screen preview render like a browser; docs do not say editor UI is hidden or iframe isolated.
FW-007: Version history autosaves checkpoints and restores named versions non-destructively; step undo is not described in the pages read.
FW-008: Primary breakpoint edits cascade to others; custom widths supported; reset overrides not documented.
FW-009: Text styles set font size, line height, letter and paragraph spacing per breakpoint.
FW-010: Hiding layers per breakpoint not found in Sites docs read.
FW-011: Variables: color, number, string, boolean with collections, modes and aliases; available in Sites.
FW-012: Text styles exist and are available in Sites; semantic tag is set per layer, not per style.
FW-013: Components and instances supported; only instances placed on webpages; overrides reset or detach.
FW-014: Component properties (text, boolean, swap, slot) with instance overrides and per-property reset.
FW-015: Variants grouped in component sets with property values; instances pick values.
FW-016: Named slot properties with preferred instances and layer count limits.
FW-017: Libraries publish and share components, styles, variables with review of updates; no versioned manifest.
FW-018: Sites CMS collections with Title, Slug, text, rich text, link, image, date fields; 200 item beta cap.
FW-019: CMS pages give each item its own URL from one template, using the item slug.
FW-020: Text, image fills and links connect to CMS fields via Connect view.
FW-021: CMS lists repeat items with a limit; list-level empty state not documented.
FW-022: Docs say filtering or sorting a CMS list is not currently supported.
FW-023: Limit property exists; filtering, sorting and pagination not supported, manual order only.
FW-024: CSV import with field type mapping and unique slug requirement; no CSV export documented.
FW-025: Field types listed have no reference or multireference type.
FW-026: Collection changes appear only after republish; no per-item draft or archived state documented.
FW-027: Hover effect and Press effect interactions; hover does not work on touch devices.
FW-028: Reveal triggers on in view or page load; scroll transform and parallax available.
FW-029: Change to action switches variants of a component set.
FW-030: Many effects and Smart Animate exist, but a multi-track timeline is not documented.
FW-031: Conditional interaction with If and Else plus set variable; overlay focus management not documented.
FW-032: No native Sites form fields documented; forms only via external embeds.
FW-033: No form submission inbox documented for Sites.
FW-034: No form webhook delivery documented for Sites.
FW-035: No form success or error state documented for Sites.
FW-036: No form spam controls documented for Sites.
FW-037: No hidden form tracking fields documented; links can carry UTM parameters.
FW-038: No multi-locale content support documented for Sites.
FW-039: No localized CMS documented; CMS docs list no locale fields.
FW-040: Site and page language code can be set; no hreflang or localized slugs documented.
FW-041: No built-in machine translation workflow documented for Sites.
FW-042: Site and page SEO title, description, social image, noindex; CMS title templates not documented.
FW-043: No sitemap or robots.txt generation documented; only a per-page noindex tag.
FW-044: Apex and www domain redirect only; no per-path redirect rules documented.
FW-045: Per-layer HTML tag, alt text, decorative via Hidden, and aria-label labels.
FW-046: Sites lists issues before publish and has a manual contrast tool; no node IDs or severity levels documented.
FW-047: Custom code can be added to the site head, so JSON-LD can be pasted; no JSON-LD editor or serializer.
FW-048: Editor preview at breakpoints, but no immutable release snapshots or shareable preview paths documented.
FW-049: Publish history lets you republish a previous version, which goes live immediately.
FW-050: Custom domains on paid plans with DNS verification and automatic SSL; Figma hosts the site.
FW-077: One favicon chosen from a canvas image (48px advised); no dark variant or Apple touch icon documented.
FW-078: One password for the whole site or per page on paid plans; Enterprise admins can require it.
FW-079: No built-in QR code feature found in official docs; community plugins could not be fetched.
FW-051: Branches are isolated copies with review requests, conflict resolution and merge; Org and Enterprise plans.
FW-052: Comments pin to top-level frames only; access roles (view, edit) control who can comment or edit.
FW-053: Live multiplayer cursors with up to 200 simultaneous editors per file.
FW-068: Branch reviewers can approve before merge, but no approval gate before publishing a site.
FW-054: REST API reads files and posts comments; variables can be written (Enterprise); no full design node CRUD.
FW-055: Figma MCP server (hosted) gives agents design context and canvas write tools.
FW-056: MCP access and writes follow seat and file permissions; an attributed audit trail is not documented.
FW-057: Sites code components are React with props and npm packages; instances stay linked. Export not documented.
FW-058: Make apps can use Supabase secrets or Payload env vars for private API keys; no visual fetch descriptor.
FW-059: Make code downloads as a zip (React source); Sites has no documented static HTML export.
FW-060: No portable export of CMS pages or locales found in official docs.
FW-061: Save local .fig copy and re-import, but it loses history and comments and relinks components.
FW-062: No native catalog, variants or inventory in Sites or Make found in official docs.
FW-063: No native cart, payments, shipping or tax checkout found in official docs.
FW-064: Site password protection only; Make Payload backends add accounts and permissions.
FW-065: Google Analytics ID and cookie consent categories; no experiments or A/B assignment documented.
FW-066: Libraries share color and text styles, variables and logo components, usable via pickers.
FW-067: Figma Buzz template guidelines lock logos, text and images; no color or font restriction or brand check.
FW-069: Figma Make builds editable web apps and sites from prompts with attached frames and images.
FW-070: Sites AI rewrites, translates, shortens text and changes tone; paid plan with credits.
FW-071: Make an image from a prompt in Design, Sites and Buzz; no provenance metadata documented.
FW-072: AI remove background plus lasso erase or isolate of image areas; paid plans.
FW-073: Buzz has a built-in Unsplash stock library; no bundled icon library or per-asset license data documented.
FW-074: Buzz bulk create maps CSV or XLSX columns to text and image layers, generating assets rather than pages.
FW-075: Published libraries share styles, variables and components across files with access control.
FW-076: Embed blocks for iframe content such as video and Google Maps; embeds wait for cookie consent. No allowlist.
FW-140: Docs state filtering or sorting a CMS list is not currently supported.
FW-141: No slider or carousel bound to a CMS list documented; interactions list only marquee and scroll effects.
FW-142: Tables exist in FigJam and Slides; Sites exposes table roles, but no semantic table element.
FW-143: Collection items can be reordered by drag; no collection folders documented.
FW-144: Duplicating a CMS page template is not documented; only layer duplication within a page is.
FW-145: Nested lists and multi-level references are not documented; field types lack references.
FW-146: Type settings offer superscript and subscript; baseline shift is not documented.
FW-147: No site or file level default gap, padding or columns documented for auto layout.
FW-148: Sites sets alt text and tags manually and has a color contrast tool; no automated audit of these checks.
FW-149: No multi-step forms, upload fields or validation presets documented; forms only via embeds.
FW-150: Export docs list PNG, JPG, SVG and PDF and do not mention comments or annotations.

FW-082: Alpha and luminance masks are documented; invert and link options are not.
FW-083: Stroke position menu sets inside, outside or center.

FW-086: Group and ungroup with shortcuts; double-click selects a layer inside a group.

FW-088: Variable width tool adjusts stroke thickness along the path; presets and width points exist.
FW-089: Align and distribute spacing tools arrange selected layers.
FW-090: Snaps to object centers and edges with red guides; pixel grid snapping available.
FW-091: Numeric X/Y, rotate, flip and rotation origin; shear and Transform Each are not documented.
FW-092: On-canvas rotate and resize handles exist; shear and perspective handles are not documented.
FW-093: Linear and radial repeat transforms exist; blend between shapes, grid and mirror are not documented.
FW-094: No warp presets or distort effects found in official docs.
FW-095: Text on a path tool with start handle and flip side; size and offset controls not described.
FW-096: SVG can be pasted into a file; no sanitizing import route, and marker and pattern elements are dropped.

FW-153: No build-your-own desktop app feature found in official docs.
FW-154: MCP server write tools and an actions menu exist; no unified command registry or Allow/Deny prompts documented.

FW-156: Components with linked instances that update from the main component; detach and swap documented as articles.
FW-157: Vectorize converts images with full color, grayscale and black and white modes; no presets or Ignore White.
FW-158: Stretch and scatter brushes and custom brushes from closed paths; no calligraphic, art or bristle types.
FW-159: Dash and gap pattern syntax and arrow tips on line ends; corner alignment and tip placement not documented.
FW-160: Select matching layers, inverse selection, lasso in vector edit and eyedropper for color; no magic wand or appearance copy.

FW-162: Rulers, drag-out guides, pixel grid snapping and an outlines view; lock, hide and clear guides not documented.

FW-175: Area text wraps in a drag-sized box; flowing into any closed path, insets and overflow indicator not documented.
